title: Jessica Meir, Sophie Adenot make history with all-female spacewalk

Their 6-hour-49-minute mission involved replacing key equipment on the International Space Station. Meir, a marine biologist who studied extreme-environment animals, brought a scientific background to spaceflight, while Adenot transitioned from aerospace engineering and helicopter test piloting. Their journeys highlight the diverse career paths, specialised expertise and teamwork that can lead to becoming an astronaut.

Stricter annual quotas and country-specific limitations contribute significantly to immigration backlogs, with nearly one million Indian applicants currently affected. This scenario exposes the disproportionate challenges facing Indian professionals in their quest for residency.

The nonprofit raised $1.5 million and spent about $1.1 million, with $469,000 listed for management and $446,000 for charity. Kelce’s business manager Aaron Eanes disputed the figures, saying some charitable operational costs were misclassified. He said management fees dropped to zero in 2025 as the foundation works to improve transparency and governance.

Doctors were evaluating her for a possible heart-lung transplant after surgery was ruled out. She experienced a sudden decline in health and suffered cardiac arrest early Tuesday morning. Her father is seeking answers regarding the circumstances surrounding her death.
